item.title: David participated at the MIB Future Panel in Bonn
item.description: It was an exciting to present our research on Lymph Node Metastasis Detection in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma at the MIB Future Panel 2024. Hosted by the Medical Imaging Center Bonn in partnership with Universitätsklinikum Bonn and the Medical Faculty of Rheinische Friedrich-Wilhelms-Universität Bonn, this symposium united thought leaders from both academia and industry. The event highlighted the critical importance of multi-center collaborations for the development of robust Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD) systems, which are essential for providing radiologists with reliable tools suited for real-world clinical application.

item.title: David participated with a poster presentation at the Student Retreat from BIGS Clinical and Population Science PhD program
item.description: David participated in the Student Retreat 2024 organized by the BIGS Clinical and Population Science PhD program in Bonn, Germany. This event was an invaluable opportunity to present my research in a poster format, engage with fellow scholars, and exchange scientific knowledge. The retreat provided a platform to receive constructive feedback on my work, expand my network, and enhance my understanding of diverse research topics within clinical and population science.
